verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs cover API access tokens that can be scoped to restrict operations, explicitly so you can build integrations. That confirms a programmatic API exists to drive the product. However, the pack has no API reference or endpoint documentation, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the standard paths. The breadth of API coverage is therefore unproven. Missing for 10: API reference/endpoint documentation, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence of which resources the API can manage, independent hands-on corroboration of using the management API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access
